detailed_descriptions.en: From one logic gate to a computer. IT THINKS! is a hands-on hardware puzzle game about building a computer from the ground up. Place parts, draw wires, watch signals move, and prove each design on a live test bench. Your first component is NAND: a tiny logic gate with two inputs and one output. From there, your designs grow into arithmetic, memory, a programmable processor, parallel cores, matrix multiplication, and finally a chip that recognizes the shapes you draw. Every part can be built from NAND, or licensed from the factory when you would rather keep moving, and you can always come back and build it yourself. Build it. Test it. Ship it. Complete 62 handcrafted contracts across six eras, from a small workshop to an AI lab. Turn working circuits into reusable chips and build a catalogue of components you designed yourself. Program the hardware you built with a compact assembly language and run the same kernel across many cores. Balance real architectural trade-offs such as area, speed, memory bandwidth, power, and parallel efficiency. Learn at your own pace with optional hints, short concept lessons, the Master's Notebook, and tests that let you skip what you already know. Show off every solution with exportable die views and looping GIF captures. No electrical-engineering background is required. You learn by building: try something, see what happened, and improve it. Beyond the campaign Build your own devices on the free bench. Add buttons, a keypad, seven-segment displays, a 16×16 lamp matrix, a buzzer, and dice, then switch to the front panel and use what you made. A bench holds up to 4,000 parts. Share a device with a link. Anyone who opens it can press its buttons in a browser, with no account. Take client orders between contracts and grow your workshop through nine levels. Solve a new puzzle every day and see where your design ranks. Play community puzzles and publish your own. Coming from the demo? Your progress carries into the full game: automatically from the Steam demo, or with a save file from the browser demo. Make it comfortable: six colour palettes or your own, a choice of typefaces including two high-legibility fonts, and full controller support. Languages: The interface, lessons, and all in-game text are available in all 22 languages listed on the store page. We taught sand to think.
